verdict.rationale: Stripe documents platform-enforced spending controls that set spending limits per authorization or per month and block merchant categories, countries, and merchant IDs, and agent cards come with built-in spend controls. That covers platform-enforced amount caps, but only some of the windows and none of the velocity rules the story asks for. The synchronous real-time authorization webhook does not count here, because it relies on the user's own code to approve or decline. Missing for 10: evidence of per-cardholder (vs. per-card) limit scoping, daily and all-time windows, transaction-count velocity rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
